description: Lockport, NY – Today, New York State Senator Rob Ortt, alongside Assembly Members Mike Norris and Angello Morinello, discussed the passage of Senate Bill S.9241 and Assembly Bill A.10399. The legislative action clearly defines that the Department of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation is tasked with the oversight of the Lockport Cave and similar businesses.
